commands.name: inspect_atmosphere
commands.description: Inspect the current environment's atmosphere: sun direction, height, color and strength, sky (installed HDRI or gradient), stars, exposure, ambient light, fog, haze and shadow distance, which of them are edited, and the installed skies.

commands.name: preview_atmosphere
commands.description: Preview atmosphere changes for the current environment. Set only the fields to change. Sun elevation below 0 is night; stars show once the sun is down. reset clears earlier edits first. The preview stays until saved or discarded.

commands.name: save_atmosphere
commands.description: Save the previewed atmosphere for this environment.

commands.name: discard_atmosphere
commands.description: Discard the atmosphere preview and restore the saved atmosphere.
